title: Typical design parameters of A2O process

cell_spans.description: Printed group heading 'HRT(hours)' spans the Anaerobic, Anoxic and Oxic sub-headings

markdown:
| F/M as MLVSS | SRT (days) | MLSS (mg/L) | Anaerobic | Anoxic | Oxic | Return activated sludge (% of influent) | Nitrified Recycle (% of influent) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0.15-0.25 | 4-27 | 3,000-5,000 | 0.5-1.5 | 0.5-1.0 | 3.5-6.0 | 20-50 | 100-300 |
notes: Source: Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection

Transcriber layout note: header is printed on two levels. Upper level reads 'F/M as MLVSS / SRT (days) / MLSS (mg/L) / HRT(hours) / Return activated sludge (% of influent) / Nitrified Recycle (% of influent)'; lower level reads 'Anaerobic / Anoxic / Oxic' under HRT(hours).
Printed as 'HRT(hours)' with no space before the parenthesis; retained.
The three HRT cells print a range broken over two lines (0.5- / 1.5, 0.5- / 1.0, 3.5- / 6.0); each is written as the single printed range.
The narrow HRT column header prints 'Anaer' and 'obic' on two lines (line wrap); joined as 'Anaerobic'.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 300-420 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: Every heading and the single data row read from a 420 dpi crop.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every cell, header and note against 144-dpi region renders (all five rotated T5.29 regions included). Corrections: 'Anaer obic' is a printed line wrap, not a spelling; joined with a layout note
